$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

modelRef.description: User-global Wiki contradiction judge, in provider/model format without a thinking suffix. Desktop knowledgeCheck.modelRef can override it. Empty means no judge is selected; Search and session models are never used as fallbacks.

thinking.description: Reasoning budget for the Wiki contradiction judge; low when empty or omitted. Desktop knowledgeCheck.thinking can override it independently of the model.

reportLanguage.description: User-global language for Wiki contradiction reports. Desktop can override it; source quotations are preserved.

knowledgeCheck.description: Wiki contradiction judge and report preferences, read from the user-global configuration.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the entire pi-tools-suite extension.

enabledModules.description: List of module names to explicitly enable, including modules that are disabled by default.

modules.description: Per-module enable/disable map. credential-firewall is disabled by default and can be enabled here.

disabledBuiltinAgents.description: Bundled async-subagent role names to hide. Project-local .pi/agents/<name>.md definitions with the same names remain available.

enabledBuiltinAgents.description: Bundled async-subagent role names to re-enable after an earlier config layer disabled them.

todoThinking.description: Enable per-todo thinking levels and automatic thinking switch/restore when tasks become in-progress/completed.

anyOf.description: Inclusive thinking bounds; min must not exceed max. Equal bounds force a level.

todoThinkingOverrides.description: Limit per-todo thinking with {min,max}. Keys support provider/model, bare-model, and * / ? wildcards; null removes an inherited policy. Invalid ranges and string values are ignored.

lookupModel.description: Vision-capable provider/model used by GLM's lookup tool; unset or null disables lookup.

lookupFallbackModels.description: Ordered lookup model fallbacks tried after lookupModel.

model.description: Exact provider/model reference used when this entry is selected.

vendor.description: Model family owner (openai, zai, anthropic, ...). Inferred from the model id when omitted.

expensive.description: Excluded from every role's selection while economy mode is on.

enabled.description: false keeps the model recognized as frontier but never selects it.

aliases.description: Glob patterns recognizing the same model under other refs, e.g. OpenRouter aliases.

roles.description: Limit this entry to the listed sub-agent roles.

frontierModels.description: Ordered frontier models used by frontier-selecting sub-agent roles (oracle, frontier-review, delivery-review). A layer's list replaces inherited entries; null restores the built-in list.

builtinAgentModels.description: Per-role model overrides for built-in sub-agent roles as provider/model[:thinking]. Later layers merge per role; null restores the suite default. Frontier roles use frontierModels.

economy.description: Economy mode: no sub-agent role selects a frontier model marked expensive. PI_TOOLS_SUITE_ECONOMY overrides it.

pruneHistoricalThinking.description: Experimental. Omit thinking from assistant turns before the latest user turn in every model request, for all providers. Saves input tokens; the current tool loop keeps its thinking, and the session/transcript keep everything. Applies to the next request. PI_TOOLS_SUITE_PRUNE_HISTORICAL_THINKING overrides it.

restrictShellWorkdir.description: Model-tools Shell/Bash aliases accept a workdir only inside the project or a /shell-workdir session grant. false allows any existing directory. Honored only in the user-level config (or PI_TOOLS_SUITE_RESTRICT_SHELL_WORKDIR); project config cannot change it. A working-directory boundary, not a filesystem sandbox.

models.description: Explicit provider/model council roster. Omit (or null) to use the enabled frontierModels in order (max 6). No automatic fallback or substitution.

thinking.description: Default participant thinking level; default high.

thinkingOverrides.description: Per-model thinking level keyed by provider/model (or bare model id). Default: zai/glm-5.3 = max. null removes an inherited entry.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-participant timeout for each round; default 600 seconds.

outputDir.description: Project-relative directory for council protocols; default .pi/brainstorms (outside the knowledge base).

quorum.description: Minimum successful participants per round; default max(2, roster − 1). Missing participants are recorded as coverage gaps.

brainstorm.description: Multi-model brainstorm council skill settings, read by its council.mjs helper. Requires async-subagents and its research role.

sound.description: Play terminal bell sound on completion/error.

enabled.description: Enable or disable comment-checker without disabling the whole module.

strictness.description: Comment classification strictness. Defaults to balanced.

maxBytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the active debug log before it is rotated. Default 5242880 (5 MB).

maxBackups.description: Number of rotated backups to keep (.1 .. .N). Default 3, minimum 1.

debugLog.description: Debug log rotation. The JSONL log is written to ~/.pi/agent/dcp-debug.jsonl.

automaticStrategies.description: Removed legacy key. Manual mode now has only the explicit enabled flag.

maxContextPercent.description: Maximum context percent (0–1 or '80%') before compression triggers.

modelMaxContextPercent.description: Per-model max context overrides using the same fraction/token/percent formats.

modelMinContextPercent.description: Per-model min context overrides using the same fraction/token/percent formats.

nudgeFrequency.description: Inject nudge every N context events.

iterationNudgeThreshold.description: Nudge after N tool calls since last user message.

protectedTools.description: Explicit verbatim tool outputs (default empty). Action facts are retained separately. Lists replace inherited pins; [] releases them.

protectTags.description: Preserve user <protect> text verbatim (default true). Disable to release tagged pins on the next replacement.

enabled.description: Enable auto candidate selection for compression.

minContextPercent.description: Minimum context usage to trigger auto-candidates.

keepRecentTurns.description: Number of recent turns to keep.

minContextPercent.description: Minimum context usage to trigger message mode.

enabled.description: Allow autonomous compression after pressure/opportunity gates. Explicit compress calls can still use summarizerModel when summary is omitted.

patience.description: Completed actionable opportunities allowed before automatic compression.

summarizerModel.description: Ordered model refs used by auto-compress and explicit compress when summary is omitted; empty uses the deterministic extractive summary.

summarizerFallbackModels.description: Ordered fallback model refs tried after summarizerModel.

timeoutMs.description: Per-summarizer deadline in milliseconds for automatic and explicit generated summaries.

enabled.description: Enable bounded same-turn emergency planning and last-resort output pruning.

hardContextPercent.description: Context fraction that activates hard emergency pressure.

targetContextPercent.description: Context fraction the emergency path attempts to recover toward.

patience.description: Completed emergency opportunities allowed before last-resort pruning.

keepRecentToolPairs.description: Newest complete tool-call/result pairs never selected by emergency cleanup.

minOutputTokens.description: Minimum tool-result size eligible for emergency pruning.

maxSuggestions.description: Maximum emergency message candidates shown in a reminder.

protectedTools.description: Additional tools protected from emergency pruning and manual sweep.

deduplication.description: Removed legacy key; no automatic replacement policy maps to it.

purgeErrors.description: Removed legacy key; no automatic replacement policy maps to it.

autoToolPruning.description: Removed legacy key. Use explicit /dcp sweep or DCP compression/emergency policies instead.

protectedFilePatterns.description: File path patterns whose matching tool outputs stay verbatim. Lists replace inherited pins; [] releases them.

pruneNotification.description: Removed legacy key; pruning notifications are no longer configurable.

^.*$.description: Partial DCP override applied to a matching provider/model or bare-model key. Keys support * and ? wildcards.

modelOverrides.description: Per-model partial DCP overrides. Exact keys take precedence over matching wildcards.

pruneNotification.description: Removed legacy key; pruning notifications are no longer configurable.

previewLines.description: Lines to show in the tool preview.

color.description: Theme color name or hex color.

previewLines.description: Lines to show in the tool preview.

color.description: Theme color name or hex color.

tools.description: Tool-specific rendering rules keyed by tool name or glob pattern, e.g. 'bash' or 'repo_*'.

description.description: Short description shown in command menu.

prompt.description: The prompt text to send. Supports {cwd} template variable.

commands.description: Command definitions keyed by slash command name.

sessionHygiene.description: Redact detected secret material from tool results and completed messages before it remains in session history.

notify.description: Show a warning when one or more secrets are redacted. Secret values are never included in notifications.

secretFirewall.description: Settings for the opt-in credential-firewall module.

remote.description: Git remote URL for the private registry. The repository contains reusable top-level skills/ and agents/ plus project-scoped state under projects/.

branch.description: Registry branch used for install/update/push/pull. Defaults to main.

projectKey.description: Optional explicit key for this project's projects/<key>/tasks.sqlite, plans/, and workspace.jsonc state. Normally derived from the current Git origin.

resourceRegistry.description: Private Git-backed registry for reusable skills/agents and project-scoped tasks/plans state.

showRateLimitWarnings.description: Show Claude Code approaching-quota warnings. Disabled by default; quota usage and actual rejection errors remain visible. Reload or restart sessions after changing this setting.

autoRotate.description: Automatically use another Claude Code OAuth profile after a structured subscription rate-limit rejection. Each profile is tried at most once per request; disabled by default.

selectedAccount.description: Preferred OAuth profile name from accounts. Manual selection applies to the next Claude Code model request, even when automatic rotation is off. If the profile is removed, falls back to the default.

rotationDelaySeconds.description: Non-blocking pause (seconds) before trying another OAuth profile after an explicit subscription quota rejection. Defaults to 60; 0 skips the pause. Cancel stops waiting; the pause counts toward the request timeout.

name.description: Friendly label for this OAuth subscription profile.

configDir.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to a separate Claude Code configuration directory. Authenticate using CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=... claude auth login.

accounts.description: Ordered OAuth profiles; auto-rotation requires at least two unique names and directories.

claudeCodeProvider.description: Claude Code subscription failover. Only the user-level file is trusted; OAuth tokens stay in Claude Code's own store.

codeExtensions.description: Complete Code file extensions. Empty disables this category. Omitted uses the displayed defaults. Optional leading dot; case-insensitive. Must not overlap Knowledge extensions. Applied on the next explicit scan; saving does not start embeddings.

knowledgeExtensions.description: Complete Knowledge file extensions. Empty disables this category. Omitted uses the displayed defaults. Optional leading dot; case-insensitive. Must not overlap Code extensions. Paths/globs are not supported; normal ignore and safety rules still apply.

embeddingProvider.description: Provider used for shared native Code/Knowledge and history embeddings.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model used for Code and, by default, Knowledge.

embedding.description: Explicit global authorization for semantic search across projects and sources; never populated by shipped defaults.

rootMarkers.description: Files that indicate a project root (e.g. ['package.json', '.git']).

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Max file size to send to the server.

bin.description: Path to the language server binary.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process.

languageIdByExtension.description: File extension → language ID mapping, e.g. {'.ts': 'typescript'}.

diagnosticsWaitMs.description: Wait time for diagnostics after file change.

pullDiagnostics.description: When false, skip textDocument/diagnostic pull requests and rely on published diagnostics. Useful for servers where pull diagnostics is slow or incomplete.

waitForPublishDiagnostics.description: When false, do not wait for a fresh textDocument/publishDiagnostics notification after file change. diagnosticsWaitMs still bounds the wait when enabled.

initializationOptions.description: LSP initialization options passed to the server.

settings.description: LSP workspace/settings passed to the server.

asyncSubagents.description: Removed legacy key. Configure sub-agents in .pi/agents/*.md and model pools in .pi/agents/presets.jsonc.
